name: ShopCentral – Advanced Store Management & Analytics for WooCommerce
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
ShopCentral is a streamlined Store Manager for WooCommerce. It replaces the standard, often cluttered WordPress admin view with a lightning-fast, modern dashboard designed for high-volume store owners.

🏬 Centralized Store Management

Experience your WooCommerce store through a premium, state-of-the-art interface.

  • Premium Store Manager: View and manage your local store data in a beautiful, responsive dashboard.
  • Central Order Timeline: Track your orders in a powerful chronological timeline with real-time updates.
  • Advanced Order Filters: Filter orders by status, date, and customer details with high-speed performance.
  • Unified Analytics: Track your Revenue, Orders, Top Selling Products, and sales trends without needing external reporting tools.
  • Product & Stock Overview: Keep an eye on your product catalog, stock status (low stock/out of stock), and product performance.
  • Multi-Store Ready (Pro): Upgrade to ShopCentral Pro to connect unlimited external stores, clone products network-wide, and manage global pricing.

🏆 Advanced Features

  • Customer Insights: Analyze customer behavior and segments to generate targeted follow-ups and improve retention.
  • Marketing Tools: Built-in controllers to orchestrate marketing campaigns directly from your centralized dashboard.
  • Automation Engine (Pro): Create robust automation rules for cart abandonment, post-purchase follow-ups, and more.
  • Notification System: Seamlessly alert your team or customers via unified messaging right inside your control center.
  • Export Tools: Powerful export functionalities to get your data into standard formats for external accounting and analysis.

💎 Unlock Even More with ShopCentral Pro

Take your business to the next level by connecting your entire network:
* Connect Unlimited Stores via REST API.
* Bulk Clone Products across all connected sites.
* Apply Global Price Adjustments across your network.
* Access the Advanced Automation Engine for multi-store workflows.
* Manage orders and customers for every store from one premium login.

🚀 Performance First

  • No Database Bloat: ShopCentral uses a smart proxy system for remote data, ensuring your site remains lightning fast.
  • HPOS Compatible: Fully supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shopcentral directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ShopCentral menu in your dashboard.
  4. Your current site will be added by default to the Store Manager.
  5. To connect an external store, generate REST API keys (Consumer Key and Consumer Secret) on your other WooCommerce site (WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API) with ‘Read/Write’ permissions.
  6. Click ‘Add Store’ in the ShopCentral dashboard and enter the external store’s URL and API keys.
  7. Switch between active and connected stores to manage them using the shop selector on the top nav bar of the ShopCentral Dashboard.
sections.faq:
Is my data sent to a third-party server?

No. ShopCentral connects your “Command Center” WordPress site directly to your other WooCommerce stores using the WooCommerce REST API. Your store data is not stored on any third-party servers. The optional usage tracking function only collects basic anonymous plugin usage telemetry, which can be easily disabled from the settings.

Does it sync all orders to my main database?

No. To preserve your main site’s performance, ShopCentral acts as a remote proxy viewer. It fetches remote data on-the-fly when you view the dashboard, preventing massive database bloat on your command center site.

Is it compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, ShopCentral is fully compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (formerly Custom Order Tables).
